case.title: Preference tokens restored with Java object serialization

mechanism.route: added work on the call path
mechanism.description: per-stream JEP 290 serialization filter (class allowlist plus graph and size limits)
guidance: OWASP Deserialization Cheat Sheet, Java: 'Configure serialization filters with an application-specific class allowlist and resource limits before reading objects.' https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/Deserialization_Cheat_Sheet.html
Oracle, Secure Coding Guidelines for Java SE, Guideline 8-6 / SERIAL-6: Filter untrusted serial data. https://www.oracle.com/java/technologies/javase/seccodeguide.html
Oracle, Java SE 21 Core Libraries, Serialization Filtering (allow-lists, pattern-based filters). https://docs.oracle.com/en/java/javase/21/core/serialization-filtering1.html
